Complete list; BIRD development set (n = \xres{RV2.dual.P1p.plus.n} questions, G = \xres{RV2.dual.P1p.plus.g} databases), the re-scoring sets (same-annotation set first, all-annotation set last), Spider-Realistic (G = \xres{RV2.dual.XB1.g} databases) and the feedback arms. Cluster interval: 95\% database-clustered percentile bootstrap, 10\,000 resamples, with $G$ databases as clusters; item-level interval: paired bootstrap over questions that ignores the database structure, same draw count; McNemar $p$: exact two-sided test on the discordant pairs (binary contrasts only). Units are percentage points unless the row names a ratio, AUROC or AURC. The design effect is the variance of the cluster bootstrap divided by that of the item bootstrap; a value below one does not make 11 or 19 databases enough. The reading follows the rule that governs the contrast (non-inferiority margin $-1.5$\,pp, calls ratio below 0.80, superiority over zero, or the band rule of the feedback-updated Critic arms); Changes = yes where the cluster and the item-level interval lead to different words, and the text then uses the wider; the small-cluster readings (cluster-robust $t$, exact sign-flip) of the same contrasts are in the next table, and the text uses the widest of the four. With $G = 11$ and $G = 19$ clusters the cluster intervals are themselves uncertain.}\label{tab:dual_full}\par\nopagebreak\vspace{2pt}
